text.tspan: What I learned today
GEST3015 Smart Materials: Structures and Properties · 2026-09-11
L2 hybridization (Beiser 8.5)
Molecular geometry follows valence-shell overlap: sigma along the bond axis, pi parallel to it. sp3 (tetrahedral), sp2
(trigonal planar + leftover p), and sp (linear + two leftover p) are linear combinations of s and p when that mixing
lowers the energy, as in CH4, C2H4 and C2H2. L2 also writes dsp3 / d2sp3 for PF5 and SF6 as geometry mnemonics.
VSEPR vs MO / ligand-field for d-block
VSEPR and a single hybridization label are not the right language for TiO2. Ti(IV) is d0; the gap is O 2p (VB) to Ti
3d t2g (CB). e_g points at oxygen, t2g between. Use ligand-field / molecular-orbital theory, not 'd2sp3' as an
electronic-structure assignment.
Periodic table bookkeeping
Atomic numbers must be stored, not inferred from the drawn table: the detached f-block made Hf look like Z=58. Hf is
72. Block colour is the differentiating electron (s/p/d/f), not a hybridization map. Eu is an f-block lanthanide; Eu3+
is 4f6, 7F0.
Silicon as a covalent crystal (Beiser 10.3, 10.6-10.7)
Diamond-cubic Si is four equivalent sp3 bonds, a=5.431 A, nn=2.352 A, angle 109.47 deg. The gap is indirect (VBM at
Gamma, CBM along Delta toward X), Eg=1.12 eV at 300 K, so a phonon is required. ni ~ 1e10 cm^-3; Eg/kT ~ 43.
Room temperature means occupation, not shape
kT(300 K)=25.9 meV=208 cm^-1. Orbital clouds do not change with T. Temperature enters Fermi-Dirac carrier populations
(Si, TiO2), Boltzmann populations of Eu3+ 7F_J (65.7 / 32.0 / 2.2 % for J=0,1,2), and 300 K lattice constants.
Eu3+ as a spectroscopic probe
4f sits inside 5s/5p, so ligand field is weak and bonding is ionic — no hybrid label. 5D0 to 7F1 (590 nm, magnetic
dipole) and 5D0 to 7F2 (612 nm, hypersensitive electric dipole). Thermally populated 7F1 is the basis of luminescence
thermometry.
Still outstanding
The Canva five-slide deck 'Silicon: From Crystal Structure to Semiconductor Band Gap' timed out and was not finished.
A p-n junction / solar-cell schematic is still needed for GEST3015 section V / CILO 5.
